answer: At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a whisper tag. The canyon cap is applied at intake and ripple exposes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 36 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
